reason: The original Repair07 prereg allowed ||C||_inf ||w||_inf as a cancellation-safe row scale. Before any Repair07 result, this is tightened to a componentwise backward-error scale so unrelated large state components cannot artificially enlarge the denominator.

replacement_scale.scale: max(abs(C_row @ w), abs(s), sum_i abs(C_row_i * w_i), TINY)

advantages: dimensionally tied to the actual terms in the constraint equation
does not reward unrelated large components of w
returns O(1) for a genuine same-sign uncancelled constraint violation
returns small values only when the residual is small relative to the actual operator contributions
